Next is **one small, budgeted transfer experiment**.

1. **Make the lesson actionable.** Create a new candidate version from the existing evidence: “When a string must contain meaningful text, validate its trimmed length while preserving the original accepted value.” No additional model call is needed to draft this.
2. **Test on fresh work.** Choose a small new ticket, freeze its acceptance and regression checks, and register a guidance-versus-baseline comparison with a total token limit.
3. **Decide whether further spending is justified.** Record verified outcomes, tokens and whether the advice changed the approach. An inconclusive result earns no useful-lesson credit; a promising result earns further testing.

The next input is a **fresh ticket/repository and its acceptance check**.
